subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` header make `/v1/chat/completions` ignore an arbitrary OpenAI SDK `model` value and use the agent's configured model, despite the current agent-target `model` contract?
rationale: Current code and docs deliberately make `model` an OpenClaw agent target and use `x-openclaw-model` for backend overrides, so accepting generic SDK models changes a public compatibility and precedence rule.

options.title: Approve header precedence
options.body: Allow generic request-body model values to be ignored only after `x-openclaw-agent-id` resolves to a known agent, while preserving strict validation when no valid agent header is present.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Continue requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` and direct integrations to use `x-openclaw-model` for backend model overrides.

recommendation.title: Approve header precedence
recommendation.body: Allow generic request-body model values to be ignored only after `x-openclaw-agent-id` resolves to a known agent, while preserving strict validation when no valid agent header is present.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current agent-first Gateway contract that this decision would relax or reaffirm.
